method: Rendered both final PDFs with Poppler and inspected all pages. Re-inspected changed schematic pages 1, 5 and 8 after fixing label collisions. Assembly shows reverse-side C27-C34 labels in blue. Final four PCB PDF pages inspected again after deterministic sub-5-um endpoint cleanup.
checks: No clipped page content or title blocks
No overlapping schematic labels after correction
Readable assembly drawing and distinct component references
Copper views agree with board outline, harness keepouts and analog plane layout
100 mm calibration bar and 1:1 CAD scaling; physical printer and component fit not tested
